cards.description: Search your Feed for a Static Sticker, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your Feed.

cards.name: Boost
cards.text: Search your Feed for a Basic Reaction, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your Feed.
cards.description: Search your Feed for a Basic Reaction, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your Feed.

cards.name: Forward Message
cards.text: Move a Reaction from one of your Stickers to another of your Stickers.
cards.description: Move a Reaction from one of your Stickers to another of your Stickers.

cards.name: Edit Message
cards.text: Heal 30 damage from one of your Stickers.
cards.description: Heal 30 damage from one of your Stickers.

cards.name: Unpin

cards.description: Swap your Pinned Sticker with one of your Chat Stickers.

cards.name: Delete For Everyone
cards.text: Discard a Gift attached to any Sticker.
cards.description: Discard a Gift attached to any Sticker.

cards.name: Sticker Search
cards.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your Feed. You may reveal a Sticker you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back.
cards.description: Look at the top 7 cards of your Feed. You may reveal a Sticker you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back.

cards.name: Scroll Up
cards.text: Put a Sticker and up to 2 Basic Reactions from your Archive into your hand.
cards.description: Put a Sticker and up to 2 Basic Reactions from your Archive into your hand.

cards.name: Mute Notifications
cards.text: The opponent's Pinned Sticker is now Muted.
cards.description: The opponent's Pinned Sticker is now Muted.

cards.name: Poll
cards.text: Flip a coin. Heads: draw 3 cards. Tails: draw 1 card.
cards.description: Flip a coin. Heads: draw 3 cards. Tails: draw 1 card.

cards.name: Reaction Swap
cards.text: Discard a Reaction attached to one of your Stickers. Then attach a Basic Reaction from your Archive to that Sticker.
cards.description: Discard a Reaction attached to one of your Stickers. Then attach a Basic Reaction from your Archive to that Sticker.

cards.name: Archive Dive
cards.text: Put a Bot from your Archive into your hand. You can't play a Bot this turn after playing Archive Dive.
cards.description: Put a Bot from your Archive into your hand. You can't play a Bot this turn after playing Archive Dive.

cards.name: Doomscroll
cards.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your Feed. Draw a card for each Reaction discarded this way.
cards.description: Discard the top 3 cards of your Feed. Draw a card for each Reaction discarded this way.

cards.name: Priority Notification
cards.text: Your Pinned Sticker's Moves do 20 more damage this turn.
cards.description: Your Pinned Sticker's Moves do 20 more damage this turn.

cards.name: Report
cards.text: Put 20 damage on one of the opponent's Chat Stickers.
cards.description: Put 20 damage on one of the opponent's Chat Stickers.

cards.name: Group Admin
cards.text: Draw 3 cards.
cards.description: Draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Channel Owner
cards.text: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.
cards.description: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.

cards.name: Moderator
cards.text: Switch the opponent's Pinned Sticker with one of their Chat Stickers. You choose the new Pinned Sticker.
cards.description: Switch the opponent's Pinned Sticker with one of their Chat Stickers. You choose the new Pinned Sticker.

cards.name: Spam Filter
cards.text: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their Feed and draws 4 cards.
cards.description: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their Feed and draws 4 cards.

cards.name: Verified Badge
cards.text: Search your Feed for a Sticker that upgrades one of your Stickers in play, and upgrade it now. Shuffle your Feed.
cards.description: Search your Feed for a Sticker that upgrades one of your Stickers in play, and upgrade it now. Shuffle your Feed.

cards.name: Community Manager
cards.text: Search your Feed for up to 2 Static Stickers and put them onto your Chat. Shuffle your Feed.
cards.description: Search your Feed for up to 2 Static Stickers and put them onto your Chat. Shuffle your Feed.

cards.name: Tech Support

cards.description: Heal 60 damage from your Pinned Sticker.

cards.name: Reaction Rush
cards.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Reactions from your Archive to one of your Stickers. That Sticker can't attack this turn.
cards.description: Attach up to 2 Basic Reactions from your Archive to one of your Stickers. That Sticker can't attack this turn.

cards.name: Ban Hammer
cards.text: Discard 2 Reactions from the opponent's Pinned Sticker.
cards.description: Discard 2 Reactions from the opponent's Pinned Sticker.

cards.name: Influencer
cards.text: Draw cards until you have 6 in hand. If your opponent has more Stars remaining than you, draw until you have 8 instead.
cards.description: Draw cards until you have 6 in hand. If your opponent has more Stars remaining than you, draw until you have 8 instead.

cards.name: Troll

cards.description: Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a Bot or Admin there and shuffle it into their Feed.

cards.name: Founder
cards.text: Search your Feed for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your Feed. You can only play this card if you have taken no Stars yet.
cards.description: Search your Feed for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your Feed. You can only play this card if you have taken no Stars yet.

cards.description: Muted Stickers need two heads on their wake-up flip to recover.

cards.name: Reaction Wall
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may attach a Basic Reaction of their Pinned Sticker's type from their hand to their Pinned Sticker. This does not count as their Reaction attachment.
cards.description: Once during each player's turn, that player may attach a Basic Reaction of their Pinned Sticker's type from their hand to their Pinned Sticker. This does not count as their Reaction attachment.
